meta.title: Walkback — receipts for onchain claims
meta.description: Sources make claims. Walkback checks them against Sui mainnet and demotes the ones that get it wrong.

footer.record: Every claim, verdict and score version is written to Walrus Memory on mainnet.
footer.bound: Trust is a Wilson lower bound. A void is not a lie.

voidReason.deadline: Deadline ({deadline}) has not passed; nothing to check yet.
voidReason.placeholder: Address {address} is a placeholder, so the claim was not checked and does not affect the trust score.
voidReason.manual: Manual claim; no automated check applies.
voidReason.noSnapshot: No snapshot was taken when this claim was ingested, so the change cannot be measured. A claim without a receipt is not a claim.
voidReason.replayTruncated: Transaction history for {address} exceeded the replay window ({blocks, number} blocks read); the total is unknown, so no verdict.
voidReason.rateUnsupported: The rate feed does not cover {pair}; the claim type is disabled.
voidReason.synthetic: Synthetic claim is excluded from the trust score.

feed.intro: A source falls below {mute} and its claims stop appearing here. Trust is a Wilson lower bound over adjudicated claims — one correct guess is not evidence.
feed.apiHintAfter: to the Coolify API origin, or check that the API container is healthy.
feed.hidden: {count, plural, one {# claim from a muted source is not shown.} other {# claims from muted sources are not shown.}}
feed.meterBody: Fill is the score. The two ticks are the mute ({mute}) and trust ({trust}) thresholds.
feed.verdictBody: True and false are judgements. Void means we could not check — it never moves a score.
feed.scoreBody: Wilson lower bound, then hits over adjudicated claims. Sample size is always visible.
feed.emptyTitle: No claims in the ledger yet.
feed.emptyBody: Paste a post that makes a checkable claim about onchain state. Walkback freezes a balance snapshot, waits for the deadline, then checks it against Sui mainnet.

ingest.title: Turn a post into a receipt.
ingest.body: Walkback extracts claims that can be checked against Sui, freezes a balance snapshot at this moment, and writes each one to Walrus Memory. Most posts contain nothing checkable — that comes back as zero claims, not as an error.
ingest.tokenBefore: The first write in a tab asks for the admin token (ADMIN_TOKEN on the Coolify backend). The browser keeps it in sessionStorage and sends it as
ingest.addressHint: optional — needed to take a receipt
ingest.workingDetail: Working{status, select, none {} other { ({status})}}. Extraction is quick; each memory write to Walrus takes about 6 seconds.
ingest.addressError: Sui address must be 0x followed by hex.
ingest.publishedRequired: Published time is required. It anchors any deadline in the post.
ingest.tokenRejected: Admin token was rejected. Submit again and enter the Coolify ADMIN_TOKEN.
ingest.tokenPrompt: Admin token for writes. This is ADMIN_TOKEN on the Coolify backend. It stays in this tab only.
ingest.tokenRequired: Admin token is required to enqueue a write.
ingest.extracted: {count, plural, one {# claim extracted} other {# claims extracted}}
ingest.memoriesWritten: {count, plural, one {# memory written} other {# memories written}}
ingest.emptyResult: Nothing in this post was checkable. That is a normal result, not a failure — most text contains no falsifiable claim about onchain state. The source was still recorded.
ingest.noSnapshot: No snapshot was taken. Without a Sui address there is no receipt, and a change-over-time claim cannot be checked later — it will resolve to void rather than be guessed.

memory.title: The ledger behind the ledger.
memory.body: Every claim, verdict and score version is written to Walrus Memory on mainnet. Walrus is the system of record; the Postgres tables the rest of the app reads are a rebuildable projection of it.
memory.verifyBody: Pages the relayer inventory and compares it with Postgres, record by record. Replacing the projection stays unavailable until every live product-namespace memory was read, the rebuild would not shrink any table, and no seed post is unfinished.
memory.rows: newest first · {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
memory.empty: No memories in the projection yet. Ingest a post to write the first one.

rebuild.help: Verify is the demo: it reads Walrus and compares without dropping tables. Replace stays off until coverage is complete and the rebuild would not drop Postgres rows, leave an orphan, or skip an unfinished seed post.
rebuild.confirm: Replace the Postgres projection with the listed memories? This drops the current tables. Do it only after the coverage report is complete.
rebuild.reading: Reading Walrus and comparing it with Postgres.
rebuild.tokenRejected: Admin token was rejected. Click again and enter the Coolify ADMIN_TOKEN.
rebuild.replaced: Projection replaced from the listed memories.
rebuild.verified: Verification finished. Postgres was not modified.
rebuild.recallFallback: Listing was unavailable. This is a recall sample, so a missing row can still be on Walrus. Replace stays off.
rebuild.coverageRead: Every listed product memory was read. A missing row is not in that inventory.
rebuild.coverageIncomplete: Coverage is incomplete, so a missing row can still be on Walrus.
rebuild.plaintext: {unique, number} memories with plaintext from {hits, number} recall hits.
rebuild.seedPosts: {count, plural, one {# seed post with no applied_at.} other {# seed posts with no applied_at.}}
rebuild.gap: {namespace}: plaintext for {recalled, number} of {reported, number} listed

source.belowMin: Below the {count, number}-claim minimum. A perfect record on one or two claims is not evidence yet — that is exactly what the lower bound encodes, and why no band is assigned.
source.none: No claims recorded for this source.
source.spark: Trust moved from {from} to {to} over {count, number} versions
